caption:
You're doing everything right, so why does something feel off? What if the danger isn't your sin, but how sure you are that you're standing? (Galatians 2:17 devotional)

The gospel doesn't hand you a polished version of your old self in disguise — it crucifies the old and makes you brand new. Self-righteousness loves to wear the camouflage of good works, and the fall usually begins right where you feel most secure. Christ didn't come to improve you; He came to make you a new creation.
